# 4 bed detached house for sale

> SALE OF FOUR BEDROOM DETACHED COUNTRY HOUSE ON C. 0.75 ACRE AT SKAHANAGH BEG, BANTRY, WEST CORK. We are delighted to promote the sale of this commanding modern built country house of high spec finish and enjoying elevated south facing views across the Mealagh Valley. The beautifully finished residence was designed and constructed as a family home in 2014.
